001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
014
015public class SDRVolturnVSDCFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
016        
017        // Whoever owns Volturn - Achilles or Hector - gets a hit due to the VSDC insurgency.
018        protected MarketAPI market;
019
020        public SDRVolturnVSDCFactor() {
021                this.market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("volturn");
022        }
023
024        @Override
025        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
026                return true;
027        }
028        
029        @Override
030        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
031                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
032                        @Override
033                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
034                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
035                                tooltip.addPara("The uprising of the Volturn Self Defense Covenant is a drain on the resources and legitimacy of the Sindrian Diktat occupiers."
036                                                + " The VSDC makes no distinction between Achilles' reformers and Hector's absolutists, viewing both as enemies of Blessed Peace.", 0f, h, "no distinction");
037                                
038                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) {
039                                        tooltip.addPara("Arroyo's smuggling operation is supporting the insurrection on Volturn.", 8f, h, "Arroyo");
040                                }
041                                
042                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_missionCompleted")) {
043                                        if(     !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverEveryone") && 
044                                                !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverRobedMan")) {
045                                                tooltip.addPara("The VSDC is displaying unusually skillful operational planning, as if their forces were advised by an experienced officer.", 8f, h, "experienced officer");
046                                        }
047                                }
048                        }
049                };
050        }
051
052        @Override
053        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
054//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
055                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
056        }
057        
058        @Override
059        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
060                
061                int _multiplier = 1;
062                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveWeaponsVSDC")) _multiplier++;
063                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveCreditsVSDC")) _multiplier++;
064                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveSuppliesVSDC")) _multiplier++;
065                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerHelpedVSDCfinished")) _multiplier++;
066                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) _multiplier++;
067                
068                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_missionCompleted")) {
069                        if(     !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverEveryone") && 
070                                !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverRobedMan")) {
071                                _multiplier++;
072                        }
073                }
074
075                String _owner = market.getFactionId();
076                if(Factions.DIKTAT.equals(_owner)) {
077                        return (SDRPoints.VSDC_HINDER_ACHILLES + SDRPoints.VSDC_HINDER_ACHILLES) * -1 * _multiplier;
078                }
079                else if(Factions.DIKTAT_ACHILLES.equals(_owner)) {
080                        return (SDRPoints.VSDC_HINDER_ACHILLES + SDRPoints.VSDC_HINDER_ACHILLES) * _multiplier;
081                }
082                
083                return 0;
084        }
085
086        @Override
087        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
088                return "VSDC uprising on Volturn";
089        }
090        
091        @Override
092        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
093                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
094                return Misc.getGrayColor();
095        }
096
097        
098}
